concerns.location: tasks.md:T008 (Execution order note: 'T008 is [P] relative to T004–T007')
concerns.text: T008's [P] tag is unsafe. (1) T008 writes `runtime_seconds` into `results/metrics.json`, the SAME file T004 (`importance_correlation`) and T005 (`high_uncertainty_ratio`) also write — concurrent writers to one JSON artifact is shared state. (2) T008 'wraps the full pipeline in a timer', but if executed in parallel with T004–T007 the runtime it measures excludes their work, making SC-005's measurement incomplete. (3) T008's sparse-GPR fallback modifies `code/models/gpr_trainer.py` and re-trains/re-profiles; if triggered while T004–T007 consume the dense model's outputs, those artifacts become stale relative to the final model. Either serialize T008 after T004–T007 or split the profiling/fallback work from the metrics.json write.
